publications.name: Do chopped fibers matter? Process–structure–property relationships and thermal annealing effects in fiber-reinforced TPMS lattices
publications.summary: By combining chopped carbon fiber reinforcement with thermal post-processing, we created ultra-lightweight 3D-printed TPMS lattices that match the energy absorption of metals while boosting toughness by 60%.

publications.name: Microstructural and surface analysis of NiTi TPMS lattice sections fabricated by laser powder bed fusion
publications.summary: Unlocking complex geometries in hard-to-machine NiTi alloys: Our research maps how Laser Powder Bed Fusion parameters directly control microstructure, Ni evaporation, and phase distribution in advanced TPMS lattices.
